recommendation: DATA AUDIT FINDING: 97.0% of objects are small (<32x32 or <1% area). Downscaling large images (median resolution ~3024x3096) directly to 512x512 eliminates fine details. RECOMMENDATION: Use 640px overlapped tiling (20% overlap) with full-image downscaled anchors. Targeted augmentations for water glare and turbidity must be enabled without vertical scene flips.
